LCTB.description: Load Contribution (LCTB). Read-only view of a named load contribution set whose members are load-case factor items (BASE_ITEM). Requires the AIJ-ASD02 steel design code to be activated first via PUT /TEMP/DESIGN/STEEL/AIJ-ASD02/DCO. Only GET and DELETE are routed; the handler's write bodies are empty, so writes are silent no-ops - load contributions cannot be created or modified through this endpoint (use the UI or the model file). DELETE removes the load contribution.

BASE_ITEM.description: Load Contribution Items; each item pairs a factor with a load case.

FACTOR.description: Factor applied to the load case.

LOAD_CASE_NAME.description: Load Case Name (resolved from the load case key on read).
